question: Can a regular finite singlet counterterm remove the first-Q two-copy interaction of the specified local pair family?
acquisition: symbolic reduction of three previously derived rational contractions, with no occupation score or parameter fit
general_regular_family: K(Q)=g(Q)*Kreg+a(Q)*L with g,a real analytic at Q1; pure pair coefficient one means g=1 and c(Q)=1+(Q-1)*a(Q)
fixed_contraction: four disjoint exterior colour lines between two identical D4 local tensors, realizable by the existing L17 contractible two-hole graph
conditional_baseline: Q^4+(v_x+v_y+v_x*v_y)*Q; v_x,v_y positive; sum both hole occupations, keep exterior fixed
decision_scope: strict positive quadratic form rules out additive first-Q colour interaction in this fixed shared-four-line exterior for a nonzero first-jet direction; not a claim about summed homogeneous U or a universal CFT norm
